body: I bought both the auto face tracking and the tripod and both are AMAZING quality. The tripod is very sturdy that I do not have to worry about my phone or the tracker falling over. It does not feel cheaply made or plasticy either.

body: This bread slicer has made a noticeable difference in my daily routine. I would recommend it to anyone who bakes at home and wants even slices.

author: Melissa
body: Keyboard has a nice size it is easy to setup, comfortable, functionality is wonderful. Now I can extend work platform without pulling out my tablet in tight places. Always hated when I had a brief to do or notes to write had to lug my laptop. With this setup I have more maneuver ability. The battery is pretty good too.
productName: Saker Wireless Bluetooth Keyboard with Touchpad

author: Grant
body: This keyboard is what it purports to be. Small, light, cheap, and pocketable. I have relatively big hands and can type on it with little trouble. You had never use this as your all day everyday keyboard though. Or I wouldn t. It is just too small. It goes in my pocket or bag when I need an emergency keyboard, or potentially if im attending a one hour meeting or something. Pairs great with a phone.
productName: Saker Wireless Bluetooth Keyboard with Touchpad

author: Luke H.
body: Highly recommend this for the hobbyist. You would not regret it under proper setup and use.

author: June L.
body: My son fractured his hand playing football last year and had to have hand surgery. After undergoing physical therapy, he still had to increase his hand strength. This helped his hand so much. It is adjustable so you can increase the difficulty of it. Easily portable and good quality!
productName: Sakerplus Adjustable Grip Trainer

body: This keyboard has been a game changer for my tablet! Works amazing, keys are very responsive, connects quickly to my tablet maybe 5 secs max, battery life is awesome, great price point, very compact. Definitely recommend this keyboard for anyone looking for a foldable and compact keyboard for your tablet!
